description: Create the correlator.py (multi-target correlation engine) and prioritizer.py (AI-based scoring). These are the two core intelligence modules. The correlator links findings across targets to identify attack chains and systemic issues. The prioritizer ranks findings by exploitability, business impact, and bug bounty value using weighted rule-based scoring.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/super_monster/correlator.py (~2500 lines): CorrelationEngine class. Load findings from FindingDB or directly from Monster JSON files. Build correlation graph: nodes=findings, edges=correlations with confidence scores. Implement correlation types: SAME_VULN_MULTI_TARGET (same vuln on multiple hosts, confidence based on exact match vs similar), ATTACK_CHAIN (Finding A on host1 + Finding B on host2 = combined attack, e.g. missing HSTS + CORS + insecure cookie = MITM session hijack), SHARED_INFRASTRUCTURE (same IP/CDN/certificate via SAN domains detection), COOKIE_SCOPE_ATTACK (cookie set for .domain.tld accessible from any subdomain), TECH_STACK_CORRELATION (same framework version everywhere = one exploit fits all), ESCALATION_PATH (low-sev + another low-sev = high-sev combined). Correlation rule engine with configurable rules. Confidence scoring (0.0-1.0) for each correlation. Generate composite findings when confidence > 0.7 with escalated severity. ASCII attack chain visualization. Output: correlation_report.json, attack_chains.md, escalated_findings.json.

Create /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/super_monster/prioritizer.py (~2500 lines): PriorityEngine class. Scoring factors with weights from config: CVSS Base (0.25), Exploitability (0.20: auth required -3, user interaction -2, network accessible +3, public exploit +5), Business Impact (0.25: payment domain +5, auth domain +4, user data +3, public-facing +2), Bug Bounty Value (0.15: common/dupe -3, novel +5, chainable +3, clear PoC +2), Correlation Bonus (0.15: found on 5+ targets +4, part of attack chain +5, systemic +3). Domain classification: auto-detect business tier from domain name (payment/checkout=CRITICAL, auth/member/login=HIGH, api/my/cart=HIGH, www/m/shop=MEDIUM, dev/staging/test=LOW). Dupe probability estimation by finding type (missing HSTS=90%, CORS=40%, subdomain takeover=20%, attack chain=5%). Priority-ranked output with submission recommendations (SUBMIT IMMEDIATELY, SUBMIT, CONSIDER, SKIP). Estimated bounty ranges. Colored terminal output showing ranked list.
acceptance_criteria: CorrelationEngine can load findings from Monster JSON output and build a correlation graph
CorrelationEngine identifies SAME_VULN_MULTI_TARGET when same finding type appears on multiple hosts
CorrelationEngine detects ATTACK_CHAIN patterns combining multiple low-severity findings into high-severity chains
CorrelationEngine generates composite findings with escalated severity when confidence > 0.7
CorrelationEngine outputs correlation_report.json with all correlations and confidence scores
PriorityEngine produces a scored and ranked list of findings using the weighted formula
PriorityEngine auto-classifies domains by business tier based on domain name patterns
PriorityEngine provides dupe probability and submission recommendations for each finding
Both modules produce professional colored terminal output
python -m super_monster correlate --input ./monster_output/reports --output ./test_correlate runs without error
python -m super_monster prioritize --input ./monster_output/reports --output ./test_prioritize runs without error
verification: python -c "from super_monster.correlator import CorrelationEngine; print('Correlator OK')"
python -c "from super_monster.prioritizer import PriorityEngine; print('Prioritizer OK')"
